auto | <language code>: language of the mod's own texts (auto = the game's language; any lang/language_xx folder works; fallback en)
Failed tries to insert the Overview / ASW items into the map menu before the layer list fallback takes over
[Mem] WARN in the BepInEx log when the process private memory grows by more than this many GiB in 10 minutes (or passes 60% of RAM); the minute line is in BepInEx/voicebot_ui_memory.log
Heartbeat: add ms=<avg>/<max> top=<module>:<avg>/<max> (time of the mod's modules per frame)

true = ASW and CAP buttons on the game's bottom panel; false = take them off (the map menu items and the hotkeys stay)
Failed tries to insert the ASW / CAP buttons into the game panel before the module gives up until the next mission

smart | replace | off: what the Orders field of a unit shows while the mod drives it. smart = the mod label, plus the game text after a dot when the game text says more than moving or waiting; replace = the mod label only; off = the game text only
Positions, widths and collapsed sections of the mod windows (written by the mod)
How many waves (issued stages) Auto makes against one target or set of targets, then stops (1..3)
How many seconds the stage-2 aircraft of a clearing wait for the neighbour to sink (120..1800)
Log every step of the Strike module
A deck order counts as failed when the aircraft is not in the air this many seconds after its ready time (60..3600)
Strike window: groups of aircraft with anti-ship missiles, plans of a missile strike, the wait point
The jammer stays on this many seconds after the last arrival (0..60)
Seconds before the strike group enters the missile radius of a hostile fighter at which a jammer starts to jam it (0..1800, 0 = do not jam fighters)
A jammer that left an air threat returns to its station after this many seconds without a threat (0..600)
Margin in nm over the missile radius of a hostile fighter that a jammer keeps from it (0..30)
An aircraft goes home when its spare path over the way home is at or below this many nm (0..100)
How long a launch waits for a lost contact before it is skipped, s (0..600)
Opens the Strike window: Unity KeyCode names joined by + (e.g. LeftAlt+H); several candidates joined by | - the first one no game binding and no other hotkey of the mod uses wins; empty = off
Odds of sinking that a plan with the goal Sink aims at for the main target (0.8..0.9)
The most T of the second missile type of one aircraft may be moved later; over this the missile is left out of the plan, s (0..300)
Odds of a breakthrough that the plan aims at for every target (0.8..0.9)

veto | hold: how the aircraft of a group are kept from firing on their own (veto holds only anti-ship missiles; hold puts weapons on hold while they are in the group; without the engage veto patch the mode is hold)
A target that left its planned position by more than this many nm makes the plan stale (0.5..20)
Margin outside the SAM zones for the wait point and the launch points, nm (0..50)
Allowed spread of the arrival of the missiles at one target, s (5..30)
Reserve on top of the turn time (4 s + turn angle / 8 deg per s) between the order and the missile launch, s (0..30)
